subject.title: [Feature]: Add description and enum to message tool's channel parameter

question: Should the description-only schema/test fix in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/84589 be allowed to close this issue, or should enum support remain part of this issue’s acceptance criteria?
rationale: The description gap is clear and narrowly fixable, but the issue title mentions enum support while the body treats it as optional and a static enum could drift from registered channel/plugin ids.

options.title: Accept Description-Only Closure
options.body: Land the provider-name description and schema assertion, close this issue, and open a narrower follow-up only if registry-derived enum support is still desired.

options.title: Keep Enum In Scope
options.body: Keep this issue open until a dynamic enum design is implemented or explicitly rejected by maintainers.

options.title: Split The Follow-Up
options.body: Land the linked PR as a partial fix and immediately move enum behavior into a separate product/API follow-up.

recommendation.title: Accept Description-Only Closure
recommendation.body: Land the provider-name description and schema assertion, close this issue, and open a narrower follow-up only if registry-derived enum support is still desired.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combined history signal on the message-tool schema and outbound channel-selection boundary and already reviewed this issue’s scope.
